summary: BI-C64EDA33 (S2 of the T3 absorption, plan 2026-11-14-workroom-runtime-core, decisions DI-BEAADBEEB92C and DI-1B6A408A5F4F). Migration 20261114060000_workroom_effect_outbox adds the Workroom runtime's transactional outbox: WorkroomEffect, one row per side effect a runtime decision emits (start a turn, answer a provider request, revoke a session credential and so on), written in the same transaction as the decision's room log rows, runtimeSession record and receipt, then run by a leased in-process worker. It also adds the WorkroomEffectKind and WorkroomEffectStatus enums. The room's runtimeSession JSON gains generation, hostId, queuedInputs, activeTurnId and inFlight.
affectedCopies: WorkroomEffect rows: inserted, retired and settled only by apps/web/lib/workroom-runtime/runtime-commit.server.ts (inside the room's receipted command) and leased and lease-recovered by apps/web/lib/workroom-runtime/workroom-effect-store.ts through the effect worker; rows cascade away with their Workroom.
WorkCapsule.workspaceState.runtimeSession: unchanged key, five new optional fields written by the runtime commit; records written before this change read with defaults (no generation, empty queue).

privacyAssessment.sensitivity: internal: effect kind, status, lease and attempt bookkeeping, and a payload holding a turn's input text (what the room asked the session to do), a provider request summary, or a credential id (never the secret). Turn input already lives in the room log and the provider thread.
privacyAssessment.dataSubjectRights: No new content about a person. Turn input is room work content, governed with the room; rows cascade with their room.
privacyAssessment.reviewDisposition: Operational history of the room's runtime; covered by the model's telemetry-bounded lifecycle annotation (180 days on createdAt).

migration.name: 20261114060000_workroom_effect_outbox
migration.backfill: None. The table starts empty; existing runtime sessions read their new fields with defaults.
migration.rollback: Forward-only and additive. Dropping the table loses only unsettled effects, which a restart would retire anyway.

changes.lifecycleDisposition: Telemetry-bounded: settled rows are history of the room's runtime (180 days on createdAt); unsettled rows are live work. Cascades with its Workroom.

fields.reason: Foreign key to the room; governed by the Workroom asset.
Deterministic idempotency key of the deciding command (runtime-event:<generation>:<n>, effect-result:<id>:<attempt>, session-open:<generation>), not a reference.
Effect input: turn text, provider request summary, credential id or plan-limit error text. Room work content, no secret values.
Opaque per-process generation id; process-bound effects of a dead generation are retired, not replayed.
Provider or runtime error text for a failed or retired effect.
